# Copernicus Browser — Gallery Link Collection

A curated collection of real Copernicus Browser deep links, one per entry in the [CDSE public gallery](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/gallery), each resolved from its shortened share link to the full `https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/?...` URL. This page exists so an AI assistant or a script has ready-made, working examples of what a Browser deep link looks like for a real location, dataset and date — see [deep-linking.md](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/deep-linking.md) for how to build one from scratch.

Every URL below omits `visualizationUrl` — see [deep-linking.md's "Visualisation URL — omit this"](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/deep-linking.md#visualisation-url--omit-this) section for why: it is encrypted with a deploy-time secret in share links, and the app fills it back in automatically from `datasetId` when it is absent. The date shown for each entry is the imagery date carried in its URL (`fromTime`/`toTime`), not the gallery's publish date — the two usually match but occasionally don't.

Entries are listed in the order the gallery presents them. 123 of the gallery's entries are included; the rest were left out because their share link no longer resolves (an expired `sentinelshare.page.link` short link, or a link to a non-Browser viewer) or because the gallery entry has no Browser link at all (e.g. a conference announcement or a desktop-background post with no interactive view).
